findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: x402_pay_guard, get_trial_key, webshop_check, mcp_server_check, payment_run_check · Private data: x402_pay_guard, watch_alerts, get_trial_key, webshop_check, payment_run_check, eudr_geo_check · Public sink: get_trial_key, nl_neighbourhood_summary, nl_car_model, nl_schools_near, firm_check, mcp_server_check · Destructive: mcp_server_check, payment_run_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: x402_pay_guard, get_trial_key, webshop_check, mcp_server_check, payment_run_check · Private data: x402_pay_guard, watch_alerts, get_trial_key, webshop_check, payment_run_check, eudr_geo_check · Public sink: get_trial_key, nl_neighbourhood_summary, nl_car_model, nl_schools_near, firm_check, mcp_server_check · Destructive: mcp_server_check, payment_run_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
